question: Can a strictly observational, scale-normalized 16D causal prediction-error detector identify both actual change events without P99's missed triggers or false stable triggers, under matched compute and confirmed-only input?
scope: Detector-only: DO NOT modify the online causal memory predictions, restore or create dual checkpoint state; demonstrate detection before attempting new architecture.

families.A: independently seeded isotropic dyadic causal effect of 16D actions
families.B: independent anisotropic action coordinates integer floor-divided by 2**(j mod 4)

source.changed: half A->B->A hidden switch at events 24 and 48; half A->A->A
source.oracle_visibility: evaluator only, no access in detector

method.causal_weights: single fixed P86 W[16,16] online eta=1 decay=.99, same as conventional reference, no change in predictions
method.observations: confirmed action and effect only; rank16 normalized action, per-event pre-write error, no unconfirmed future
method.detector: EWMA normalized innovation surprise: error_mse / max(EMA(effect_mse),1e-6); threshold selected from FIT, require consecutive event triggers, 8-step refractory and minimum 16-step warmup; ewm scale updated on confirmed only
method.threshold_selection: FIT balanced score: sum of true-event recall at each change (within 12) minus 2*stable false-positive rate across entire FIT, tie by first frozen grid order; CAL once
method.memory: 256 float32 W plus one float32 confirmed scale + integer trigger and refractory counters; observed declared

controls: W256 fixed same exact weights and predictions, zero additional detection
P99 original event checkpoint model with FIT-only choice (historical comparator), original unchanged
Raw unnormalized squared causal innovation detector same FIT grid (control against scale normalization)
missing/unconfirmed NaN no-write and no alarm
full run wall CPU vs original W256 measured batch8, single thread, seven medians after two warmups
no hidden regime or withheld query effect used
diagnostic_policy: Return measured DEV failure when thresholds fail, never modify algorithm or regenerate CAL to retune. P100 cannot prove causal recovery since predictions remain identical W256; only detection capability is under test.

execution.artifact: existing G4 local_runs/p100_dev_result.json numeric from same pytest invocation; no new workflow
execution.final: mandatory complete G4 Windows+Ubuntu, G5 Windows+Ubuntu, G7 Ubuntu exact final SHA
